headline: Maritime Union Strike Shuts Down Operations Across 113 Ports
summary: Dockworkers and maritime staff staged a 24-hour anti-war strike affecting 113 ports globally, including operations at Greece's Piraeus port.
why: Port strikes disrupt global supply chains, shipping freight rates, and international container logistics.

impacts.name: Global Maritime Logistics
impacts.why: Operations across 113 ports were temporarily impacted by a 24-hour strike.
